title: Evidence before answers
subtitle: A fictional paper map showing how a research question becomes a testable, evidence-grounded workflow.
citation: Synthetic design example. Not a real paper; no empirical results are claimed. All section and page references are illustrative.

nodes.title: Can a verdict be checked?
nodes.summary: A useful answer should reveal which evidence supports it, not merely sound convincing.
details: This is a fictional research question used to demonstrate the map format.

nodes.title: What changes under drift?
nodes.summary: Ask whether the same evidence workflow remains useful when language, topics, and source material change.

nodes.title: Prediction is not evidence
nodes.summary: The toy comparison distinguishes a model's answer from a traceable justification for that answer.

nodes.title: Retrieval supplies context
nodes.summary: Finding relevant passages creates candidate support, but relevance alone does not establish the conclusion.

nodes.title: 01 / Retrieve candidates
nodes.summary: Turn the question into a small set of candidate passages while preserving their source locations.
details: Input: a question and a permitted document collection.
Output: candidate passages with stable source references.

nodes.title: 02 / Check support
nodes.summary: Separate supporting passages, conflicting evidence, and missing information before producing a verdict.
details: Retain uncertainty instead of treating absent evidence as a negative finding.

nodes.title: 03 / Explain the decision
nodes.summary: Return a concise answer with its evidence trail and clearly bounded uncertainty.

nodes.title: Compare like with like
nodes.summary: Illustrative protocol: hold questions fixed and compare the evidence workflow with a retrieval-free baseline.
details: No real scores are supplied. A real paper map must preserve the authors' metrics, units, splits, and uncertainty.

nodes.title: Remove the support check
nodes.summary: Illustrative ablation: remove verification to ask whether it changes citation faithfulness rather than just fluency.

nodes.title: Test changing sources
nodes.summary: A proposed next step is to evaluate the workflow when the evidence collection changes over time.
details: This is an explicitly inferred proposal, not an author-stated conclusion.

nodes.title: Keep disagreement visible
nodes.summary: Explore how conflicting sources should appear in an explanation instead of being silently averaged away.
